notes.title: The Bugfixing Effect
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] ⏰ improved alarm clock puzzle (thx: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/weyland_here]Weyland)[/url]
[list]
[*] lowered sound radius
[*] pressing wrong clocks again, won't change numbers anymore[/list] [*] 🚽 fixed missing urinals in mirror (thx: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/weyland_here]Weyland)[/url]
[*] 🔊 fixed repeating door closing sound in magenta room
[*] 🚪 fixed door that let you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3259763579]go out of bounds[/url] (thx: many people, incl. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2621420/discussions/0/4338734745069493023/]maddie[/url])
[*] 🌈 adjusted "Closet" and fixed "Head over Heel" achievement
[*] 💨 made changes in favour of speedrunning[list]
[*] speedrun timer at the end, if faster than 4min (thx: Jade)
[*] secret door opens, if faster than 4min[/list][*] 👢 footsteps volume lowered (thx: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@UncivilGamers]Uncivil Gamers[/url], Daxel)
[*] 🛠 fixed [url=https://elisioneffect.com/cheats]cheats[/url] (press 4th button in menu 3 times)
[*] ⚠️ added warning in menu (thx: [url=https://www.artstation.com/empty_studios]Empty[/url])
[list]
[*]no save function
[*] single session
[*] photosensitivity [/list]
[/list]

Bugs I am aware of but did not patch yet:
[list]
[*] Settings aren't saved across runs (Thx: many, incl. Natanox)
[*] No brightness setting (Thx: Jolly's headache)
[*] On non-typical screen resolutions, there may be unintended black bars (Thx: Tomi)
[*] SteamDeck doesn't work properly. Valve calls every Linux release a "SteamDeck" release too. Unfortunately, SteamDeck overwrites my in-game Controller input (e.g. Use is supposed to be Face Button Left, but ends up being Face Button Right). Idk why, I don't have a SteamDeck, so I won't optimize for it for now.
[/list]

Feel free to report bugs or request essential features, I may or may not get around to patch them in. Unfortunately, I have a day job and I'm very exhausted at the end of the week.

Meow :3
- Theia

notes.title: The Elision Effect Release
notes.notes:
That's right. This Friday on the 31th of May, you will be able to play The Elision Effect on Steam.
